name: Hallucination Powder Trap
disable: DC 26 Thievery check (expert) to disable the hammer that strikes the percussion cap

items.name: Powder Burst
items.text:
Trigger The latch is opened or the tube is broken.

---

Effect The tube explodes, spraying hallucinogenic powder in a 30-foot cone. Any creature in the cone must succeed at a DC 24 Will save save or be confused for 1 round and take a -2 status penalty to Perception checks and saves against mental effects for 1d4 hours. On a critical failure, the penalty is instead -4.

Effect: Powder Burst

text: A tube of hallucinogenic powder armed with a miniature explosive is connected to a doorknob or similar latch.
